title: ERA5: The new champion of wind power modelling?
method_used: ERA5 vs MERRA-2; five countries; 1051 turbines; compare simulated generation with measurements
what_it_supports: ERA5 is a credible long-term wind-power/reanalysis source and outperformed MERRA-2 in that study
what_it_does_not_support: Does not justify local turbulence, hub-height 161.37m extrapolation, NTM/ETM or structural load histories

title: Global offshore wind energy resources using the new ERA-5 reanalysis
method_used: ERA5 hourly/model-level winds used for global offshore WPD/resource assessment
what_it_supports: Peer-reviewed ERA5 wind-resource precedent; importance of hourly resolution and height treatment
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore/global scope; not local Jiayu site validation

title: Evaluation of ERA5, MERRA-2, COSMO-REA6, NEWA and AROME to simulate wind power production over France
method_used: Compare reanalyses with wind-power observations over France
what_it_supports: ERA5 can support large-scale wind-energy studies but local/terrain bias must be discussed
what_it_does_not_support: Not a direct vertical extrapolation recipe for this site

title: Combination of meteorological reanalysis data and stochastic simulation for modelling wind generation variability
direct_relevance_to_thesis: Direct architecture match: reanalysis background + stochastic variability
method_used: Combine meteorological reanalysis and stochastic simulation; validate against 15-min generation measurements
what_it_supports: Strong support that coarse reanalysis and stochastic modelling have different roles; supports ERA5→TurbSim separation
what_it_does_not_support: Not a TurbSim parameter source and not an OpenFAST load-validation paper

title: The role of the power law exponent in wind energy assessment: A global analysis
method_used: Hourly ERA5 10m/100m winds; derive time-dependent/spatially explicit alpha; compare with mean alpha and 0.14
what_it_supports: Directly supports deriving alpha(t)=ln(U100/U10)/ln(10) rather than blindly using 1/7
what_it_does_not_support: Global analysis; does not validate Jiayu 161.37m result by itself

title: Reliability of ERA5 Reanalysis Data for Wind Resource Assessment: A Comparison against Tall Towers
method_used: Compare ERA5 with six tall towers across heterogeneous sites
what_it_supports: Requires site/topography caution and measurement validation where possible
what_it_does_not_support: Does not provide turbulence or design-load time series

title: Modeling of Ethiopian Wind Power Production Using ERA5 Reanalysis Data
method_used: ERA5 extraction/interpolation/downscaling→hub-height extrapolation→farm power curve→measurement comparison
what_it_supports: Supports an end-to-end ERA5 wind-energy workflow including hub-height conversion
what_it_does_not_support: Ethiopia/farm-power scope; not direct 10MW structural-load support

title: A global assessment of extreme wind speeds for wind energy applications
method_used: Use ERA5 hub-height wind for 50-year sustained extreme-wind atlas and compare with observations
what_it_supports: Supports ERA5 for long-term extreme climate screening
what_it_does_not_support: Not ETM turbulent realization or short-term structural loading

title: Accurate long-term power generation model for offshore wind farms in Europe using ERA5 reanalysis
method_used: ERA5 long-term hourly wind→offshore farm generation
what_it_supports: Supports long-term wind-energy use
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore; not site-specific tower loads

title: Towards global validation of wind power simulations: A multi-country assessment of wind power simulation from MERRA-2 and ERA-5 reanalyses bias-corrected with the Global Wind Atlas
method_used: Bias-correct reanalysis; compare simulated wind power across multiple countries
what_it_supports: Supports ERA5 with bias-awareness rather than treating it as truth
what_it_does_not_support: Does not define local turbulence or IEC wind models

title: Validation of European-scale simulated wind speed and wind generation time series
method_used: ERA5/NEWA/EIWR validation against tall masts and national generation; microscale scaling
what_it_supports: Strong support for ERA5 large-scale background and explicit acknowledgement of missing local/high-frequency structure
what_it_does_not_support: Does not define TurbSim grid/seed settings

title: Analysing the uncertainties of reanalysis data used for wind resource assessment: A critical review
method_used: Review 15 reanalyses, 322 locations, 40 studies
what_it_supports: Required limitation discussion: reanalysis uncertainty depends strongly on terrain/location
what_it_does_not_support: Not a single implementation recipe

title: A revised offshore wind resource assessment and site selection along the Indian coast using ERA5 near-hub-height wind products
method_used: ERA5 near-hub-height products→WPD/site selection/energy output
what_it_supports: Supports hub-height resource assessment architecture
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore India; not Jiayu validation

title: Estimating hub-height wind speed based on a machine learning algorithm: implications for wind energy assessment
method_used: Compare hub-height estimates at 120/160/200m; discuss power-law extrapolation and error growth above 100m
what_it_supports: Direct warning that extrapolating ERA5 above 100m, including ~160m, has increasing uncertainty
what_it_does_not_support: Does not invalidate power law; requires uncertainty treatment/validation

title: 基于ERA5数据的江苏海域风能资源评估
method_used: ERA5-based wind-resource/WPD/stability/reserve assessment
what_it_supports: Chinese peer-reviewed precedent for ERA5 wind-energy resource analysis
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore Jiangsu; no direct Jiayu parameter transfer

title: Spatiotemporal variation of power law exponent on the use of wind energy
method_used: Hourly ERA5 10m/100m 1980–2022; alpha varies in time/space; validate with eight wind towers
what_it_supports: Strong support for hourly/time-varying alpha and rejection of universal 1/7
what_it_does_not_support: Requires regional validation in complex terrain

title: Development of a Methodology for Preliminary Site Assessment for Offshore Wind Applications based on ERA5 Reanalysis Data
method_used: ERA5 hindcast as input to site assessment; wind statistics/AEP/extreme-wind criteria; three case sites
what_it_supports: Direct academic-thesis precedent for a structured ERA5 wind-energy methodology chapter
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore/site-assessment scope, not structural turbulence

title: 中国海域风浪时空演变特征和联合开发潜力评估
method_used: ERA5 + ocean observations for long-term wind/wave spatial-temporal evolution and energy potential
what_it_supports: Chinese thesis precedent for ERA5 long-term resource/background analysis
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore Chinese waters; not hub-height 161.37m validation

title: Evaluation of ERA5 wind parameter with in-situ data offshore China
method_used: Hourly ERA5 10m/100m compared with 19 offshore-China wind towers
what_it_supports: Strong Chinese evidence: good general skill but high-wind underestimation; validates need for caution
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore China; not onshore Jiayu correction

title: Segmented Bias Correction of ERA5 100 m Wind Speed for Wind-Resource Assessment in Complex Terrain
method_used: 459630 hourly observation-reanalysis pairs from 64 wind masts; complex-terrain bias correction
what_it_supports: Very strong local-region warning that ERA5 100m may require regime/terrain-aware correction
what_it_does_not_support: Does not prove Jiayu must use the same correction model without local validation

title: ERA5再分析资料在风能资源方面的应用
method_used: Full text not yet independently read
what_it_supports: High-priority domestic source to acquire and extract before exact method citation
what_it_does_not_support: Metadata alone cannot support exact formula/parameter wording

title: Underestimation of strong wind speeds offshore in ERA5: evidence, discussion and correction
method_used: Compare ERA5 strong winds and propose correction
what_it_supports: Supports explicit limitation statement for extremes
what_it_does_not_support: Offshore correction not transferable to Jiayu
